title: Helsinki-hetket / Kuvitukset Lille Santanen

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Introduce a civic illustration voice through ordinary life so people can recognize their city in human scenes.
strategic_value: The framed logo, bold fields and varied characters can connect Helsinki’s institutional identity to everyday experience.
demonstration: An orange-and-pink wave divides the cover behind white title and illustrator credit; people, trees and a building occupy the right side.
practical_value: Use a cover to establish the relationship between the city identity and an illustration collection before presenting its assets.

content_islands.name: Title and credit
content_islands.spec: Place the large two-line title above the smaller illustration credit at left.

content_islands.name: Illustrated life
content_islands.spec: Arrange people, dog, trees and a building across the pink right-hand area.

content_islands.name: City signature
content_islands.spec: Place the white framed logo at bottom right.

reference_purposes.Expression: The cover combines the orange/pink wave field, civic logo and character illustrations.
reference_purposes.Application: It applies those elements to the introduction of an illustration deck.
